sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: This repository contains media streaming plugin applications for the High-Rate Delay Tolerant Network (HDTN) software.

Once built, the bpsend_stream executable can be used to ingest media such as RTP packets and mp4 files, and send them to a Delay Tolerant Network (DTN) as bundles over any supported convergence layer. Similarly, the bprecv_stream executable can be used to receive bundles from a DTN and reassemble the media.

sect1.title: Installation using Docker
sect1.para: These applications depend on HDTN and Gstreamer libraries. So far, they have only been tested on Debian-based Linux distributions. The easiest way to get started is by building Dockerfile in the root directory:
And then running a container with the host network attached, like: dockerrun-it-uroot--networkhost--namehdtn-streaminghdtn-streaming:latest/bin/bash
However, if you would like to run bpsend_stream and bprecv_stream natively, you can follow the instructions below.

sect1.title: Installation on native machine and Build Dependencies

listitem.para: Build and install HDTN using the instructions located in GitHub
Install meson and the directory where it was installed to PATH sudopip3installmeson
Clone, build, and install Gstreamer gitclonehttps://github.com/GStreamer/gstreamer.git cdgstreamer&&mesonsetupbuild mesonconfigurebuild&&mesoncompile-Cbuild ninja-Cbuildinstall
Clone this repository, and build using CMake

sect1.title: Example usage with Docker
sect1.para: Tests scripts are located at tests/test_scripts_linux. After cloning this repository, and before running any test, set HDTN_STREAMING_DIR to the root of the repository, e.g.: exportHDTN_STREAMING_DIR=/home/user/HDTN-Streaming

To quickly get started using Docker:
Install Docker (https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/ubuntu/)
Download VLC sudoapt-getinstallvlc
Run the one_node_ltp test, to stream a video file using bpsend_stream, bprecv_stream, and HDTN: ./tests/test_scripts_linux/one_node_ltp/docker/run.sh
